calibration_method.detail: w_m = q(points_m) / p_hat(points_m) where q = NB2 of the direct C1 state-GLM points component and p_hat the smoothed emergent histogram; all arrays resampled with the same indices, so identities keep holding and player outcomes stay conditioned on the team score
calibration_method.name: importance resampling of joint draws to the validated team-points component
calibration_method.reason: emergent points (7 x TDs + residual) were 11% worse in CRPS than the validated direct component in a development smoke run

no_2025: all of the above uses seasons <= 2024

carries.choice: O2b: primary rushers (QB / RB / FB) activity x logistic share of the pool N - G, gadget carries G | N ~ BetaBinomial allocated by log-linear Dirichlet weights (WR / TE / OTHER)
carries.evidence: O2_carries: O2b CRPS 0.639 vs O1 B0 0.802 (-20.3%); QB -19.1%, RB -22.5%; gadget WR +4.4% / TE +10.8% worse than the per-row O1 B0 marginals on very small CRPS values: G4 fails vs O1 B0 and is NOT rescued; coherence is the structural requirement so O2b is the engine's carry component, with the gadget deficit recorded as a known limitation

team_volume.choice: V2 (N ~ NB2 C1 state GLM; D | N ~ BetaBinomial with a binomial-logistic pass share; S | D ~ Binomial)
team_volume.evidence: volume_R / volume_A / volume_N experiments: V2 logit matches the independent T1 C1 on rush attempts (CRPS 4.746 vs 4.744), improves pass attempts 0.9% CRPS but PIT-KS +0.023 (> 0.02, so the independent T2 B0 stays the SIMPLE REFERENCE for the 2025 comparison), improves total plays 3.4% (5.862 vs 6.066); coherent V2 variants with a constant pass share are much worse (rejected)

smoke_runs_disclosure: before simulator registration, small burned-development smoke runs (M = 500-1000 draws on 60-400 team-games) were inspected to debug the simulator (they led to the reweighting and the accounting-identity fixes); no 2025 data were touched

source_defect_interceptions.finding: cfbfastR attributes interceptions to the passer correctly only in 2018-2020 and 2024: INT / attempt = 2.5-2.7% (2018-2020), 1.2% (2021), 0.8% (2022), 0.7% (2023), 2.2% (2024); other event rates are stable across seasons
source_defect_interceptions.rule: INT_VALID_SEASONS = (2018, 2019, 2020, 2024): the interception component is fitted on those seasons only, as a league-constant rate (player histories spanning 2021-2023 are corrupted), and scored only on valid seasons; any 2025 interception result is reported separately as source-unverified

structural_requirement: The engine must be COHERENT: accounting identities hold draw by draw (R + A + S = N, carries + OTHER = R, QB attempts + OTHER = A, receptions + OTHER = team completions, completions <= attempts, passing yards = receiving yards, passing TD = receiving TD, points = 7 x offensive TDs + residual). Independent constructions (T1 / T2, O1 B0 / C1, per-row beta-binomial marginals) cannot satisfy this and are kept as REFERENCES / baselines; selection among COHERENT variants follows the Phase 1 gates.
type: DEVELOPMENT AMENDMENT (burned 2019-2024; no 2025): component selections, structural rules, source defect, calibration method
yard_tilt: the exponential opponent tilt is only retained if promoted; the standardized opponent index is clipped to [-3, 3] (development fix: FCS / tiny-sample outliers produced degenerate tilts; the tilt on completion events remained catastrophic and is rejected, not rescued)
